lastCompletedStory.title: Meta-loop auto-dispatcher honors a pending explicit plan_issue

nextStoryContext: US-004 (CAM-203) is the last story on this PRD: MetaLoopDispatchDeps gained two new OPTIONAL fields, readPlanIssueFn (() => string | undefined) and selectTargetFn ((targetId: string) => IssueEntry | null); both default to absent so every pre-existing dispatcher test is byte-identical (AC3). dispatchOrDrain now checks `deps.readPlanIssueFn?.()` FIRST, before calling deps.selectFn() at all: a non-empty pending id delegates entirely to a new handlePendingTarget(deps, targetId) helper and returns early, deliberately bypassing observeDecide/ctx.observeState (the drain-dedup path is a separate decision point and must not be perturbed by the pending-target branch, per the story's notes field). handlePendingTarget: (a) plannable via selectTargetFn -> setPhaseFn('planning', resolved.id) + a 'meta-loop-dispatch' {dispatched:true, issueId, rank} event, SAME shape as top-of-queue dispatch so downstream consumers (event log readers, dashboards) don't need a new case for the happy path; (b) not plannable (selectTargetFn returns null, e.g. missing/not-open/blocked target) -> emits a NEW 'meta-loop-dispatch' {refusedTarget:true, targetId} event (added as a 5th variant to MetaLoopDispatchEventDetail in events.ts) and calls setPhaseFn('idle') with NO 2nd arg, which clears plan_issue to undefined via makeSetPhaseFn's existing raw-2nd-argument-no-fallback write behavior (confirmed by re-reading makeSetPhaseFn: no new code needed for the clearing itself, same 'zero new code' discovery pattern as US-003's stale-plan_issue-cleared AC). This satisfies 'never dispatches a different issue on that tick': selectFn (top-of-queue) is never consulted at all when a pending target is present, plannable or not. Production wiring in buildProductionDispatchFn: readPlanIssueFn: makeReadPlanIssue(claudeDir) (pre-existing export from CAM-154, reused unchanged), selectTargetFn: (targetId) => selectPlanTargetFromFile(cwd, targetId) (pre-existing export from CAM-154's target-aware selector). Both AC4's grep oracle ('readPlanIssueFn' in sidecar.ts) and a same-shape assertion for 'selectTargetFn' pass. Ordering note (docs/adr/0007 safe-boundary guards): the pending-target read happens INSIDE dispatchOrDrain, which is only reached after makeProductionMetaLoopDispatchFn's returned closure has already passed the kill-switch, precondition, blocked-cycle, merge-watch, and phase-idle guards in that order -- so the pending-target branch never disturbs an in-flight plan (phase must already be idle/absent for dispatchOrDrain to run at all). Test coverage: test/commands/sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts gained a 'pending explicit plan_issue wins (US-004, CAM-203)' describe block with 5 tests: AC1 explicit-target-wins-over-higher-rank (constructs a higher-ranked top-of-queue fixture the selectFn would return, and a lower/unranked explicit target, asserts the explicit one is what gets dispatched), AC2 refused-non-plannable-clears-plan_issue (selectTargetFn returns null, asserts setPhaseFn called with ('idle', undefined) exactly once -- never a substitute dispatch -- plus the refusedTarget event shape), AC3 no-pending-target-unchanged (readPlanIssueFn returns undefined, asserts selectTargetFn is never invoked -- test throws if it is -- and top-of-queue dispatch proceeds identically to pre-US-004 behavior), AC3-companion absent-both-deps-backward-compat (omits both new fields entirely from the deps object, proving old callers/tests need zero changes), and an AC4 file-assert oracle. Ratchet note: scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings were raised for sidecar.ts (2002->2077), events.ts (524->530), and test/commands/sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts (1282->1434), each with the CAM-203 tracker ref inline in _ref. PROJECT STATE: all 4 userStories in prd.json now have passes:true (US-001 through US-004), none are requires:operator -- this PRD cycle has no more autonomous-implementer work. The very next /cam-next or cam-next invocation on this branch should see an empty selectable-story set and the orchestrator should move to /cam-review.
